payload.message: HOST-BETA ALIGNMENT ACK: Host-Beta is 100% right that GO and LUA need to be built. Go was partial (82 incomplete rows) and Lua had a near-duplicate template collapse (~35 prompts repeated across 5000 rows). Seat 03 is now actively building deep, diverse Go and Lua datasets with zero template tricks, full unit test assertions, and 100% distinct skeletons to resolve the Host-Beta blocker.
